bias.zh: 反弹 · 突破 10 日均线，仍低于 $266–278

read.en: Teradyne rose 8.3% on Nov 11 to $265.78, trading $254.75–273.22. It is above the 5-day ($237.6) and 10-day ($254.0) and below the 30-day ($328.9), 100-day ($361.8) and 200-day ($350.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($212.48), and RSI is 40.7.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月11日上涨 8.3%，收于 $265.78，盘中区间 $254.75–273.22。股价位于 5 日（$237.6）和 10 日均线（$254.0）上方，30 日（$328.9）、100 日（$361.8）和 200 日均线（$350.2）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近上穿；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$212.48），RSI 为 40.7。

read.en: The rally cleared $245.9–247.5 and the $254.2–257.8 zone (Nov 10 high, Nov 2 low, 10-day), now support; the $273.22 high faded back under the $266.4 Nov 3 low. Resistance is $266.4–269.4 (Nov 3 low and close), then $273.2–278 (Nov 11, 3 and 2 highs) and $296.8 (Jul 17 low). Support is $254–258, then $245.9–247.5 and $237.6–242.1. A close above $269.4 would target $273–278; below $254, $246–247.5.
